Fifteen (37.5%) of the 40 emergency responders who did not use respiratory protection received medical care
Seven (17.5%) of these 40 reported new or worsening symptoms within 24 hours of the response.
Forty (78.4%) of 51 emergency personnel responding to an acute phosphine exposure incident in Texas
Eleven responders (21.6%), including seven firefighters and HAZMAT team members, reported use of respiratory protection while on-scene
None of the 11 who used respiratory protection reported symptoms or having received medical care.
DSHS investigated potential occupational phosphine exposures among the 51 on-scene emergency responders

methods_quotes.q: Local health department personnel administered the questionnaire for DSHS via in-person and telephone interviews from January 23 through February 3, 2017.
data that could potentially identify an individual were suppressed if counts were fewer than five.
